## Purpose

The existing JSA argument needed figures that explain the implementation, diagnostic distinctions, finite qualification boundary and paid comparisons at normal double-column reading size. This revision uses the author's ASV reference for restrained serif typography, fine lines and evidence-led panels.

Stacked on **#72**, head `a686af6b4fb537b84a5e52a3736633d21c752801`. New version is isolated in `paper/jsa/manuscript_v0142/`; earlier manuscripts and evidence are preserved.

## Changes

- Redraw all five figures as editable PDF/SVG assets: implementation and query view; five categorical crosses plus continuation result; complete 16-mask matrix plus wider geometry; R/M/C comparator construction with saved cost intervals; all 24 tasks and four request rounds.
- Preserve failures and scope: geometry breakdown, seven request regressions, round 2 reversal, same-family limitation and B570 strong-baseline results.
- Update captions/panel references and clarify that B570 downstream changes arise under the sustained alternate continuation policy, not an isolated-block-aftereffect claim.
- Display main cost-table ratios to three decimals, leaving underlying precision and six other generated tables unchanged.
- Provide a Chinese change record and a ready-to-use **6.1sol prose-editing prompt**.

## Deliverables

[Manuscript entry](https://github.com/leecdiang/HeteroSpec/blob/codex/jsa-v0142-asv-visual-20261010/paper/jsa/manuscript_v0142/README.md)

- Main PDF: **13 pages**, normal Elsevier 5p double-column.
- Independent supplement: **27 pages**.
- Full Overleaf author-source ZIP; separate flat main/supplement source ZIPs.
- Drawing code, bound data, claim/experiment ledgers and current validation receipts.
- `VISUAL_HANDOFF_TO_SOL.md` for the next language-editing round.

## Validation

- All **5,970 baseline files** retain their Git blob hashes; all 282 added file hashes verified against the remote tree.
- Original 26 evidence exports, 16 historical copies and 133 bound source copies unchanged; numerical `compute()` AST and six supplementary tables unchanged.
- Full CPU numerical and independent standard-library checks pass. Additional drawing check verifies 48 task points, six saved ratio intervals and four rounds; vector figure text remains within canvas with no Type 3 fonts or raster chart images.
- Main and supplement compile without overfull boxes, undefined/duplicate references or missing glyphs; all fonts embedded.
- All 40 pages inspected in rendered contact sheets, all five figures inspected independently, changed supplement pages reinspected.
- Final 255-file structured ZIP fully rebuilt from an empty directory: both PDF bytes/text, all 18 generated figure/table assets and numeric QA match.
- Flat source packages separately compile with equal page counts/text; flat main PDF bytes differ and are explicitly recorded as different, without assuming the reason.

No model experiment, private raw-archive re-audit, merge, submission or public data release. Author identity/declarations, final bibliography confirmation and single-model-family scope remain unresolved author/scientific items. Full prose editing is deferred to the supplied next-round prompt.
